title: C¹ approximation of Lipschitz maps (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5), vector-valued
statement: For all n, p ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0, every K-Lipschitz map f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵖ (ℝᵈ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) and every ε ∈ (0, ∞], there is a map g : ℝⁿ → ℝᵖ of class C¹ such that the Lebesgue measure of {x : f(x) ≠ g(x) or Df(x) ≠ Dg(x)} is < ε, where D denotes the Fréchet derivative (Mathlib's fderiv, which is 0 at points of non-differentiability).
lean_statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn p) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → Rn p, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε
